display.purpose: The name LupiOS in the first viewport only. Frost, balanced.

headline.purpose: Section heads in the left column of each species account.

title.purpose: Ruled-grid entry heads, switch option names, key specimen names (1.45rem), Habitat column heads (1.6rem).

name-latin.purpose: Set in italic: the binomial, neighbour species names, plate credits (0.95rem).

body.purpose: Running text. Ledes 44ch, section descriptions 34ch, asides 66ch.

label.purpose: Real small caps (Alegreya Sans SC): table heads, trait column, nav, status tag, field-mark numerals.

code.purpose: Inline commands in frost; command names in ruled grids at 1.15rem in ice.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The only easing: soft exponential out, for every transition and the load moment.

motion.name: draw
motion.value: clip-path inset(0 0 0 100%) to inset(0) over 1.1s, 0.25s delay
motion.purpose: The plate's leader lines reveal on load.

motion.name: land
motion.value: opacity 0 and scale(0.6) to rest over 0.6s, 80ms stagger from 0.9s
motion.purpose: Field marks land in sequence after the lines draw.

motion.name: reduced
motion.value: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce removes all animation and transition
motion.purpose: The load moment runs only under no-preference.

narrative.overview:
LupiOS is shown as a species in a field guide printed for night use: total navy plates, ice-blue hairlines, numbered leader-line callouts on real photographs (VM screenshots), frost serif names with italic Latin, and small-caps labels. It continues the OS's own night identity (ice-blue wolf mark on deep navy, mountain ridges, the palette in `art/generate.mjs`), so the website, wallpapers, installer and link preview read as one brand.

Hierarchy comes from type and ink, never from boxes or light. Content is set as "species accounts": a heading column on the left, the account on the right, each separated by one hairline rule. Comparisons are ruled tables, explanations are ruled heading-and-text grids, and evidence is a plate with numbered marks. Density is that of a reference book: generous section breaks, tight ruled rows inside.

The world is dark only by design: the brand is night. The home page sets `color-scheme: dark` on its root and offers no light variant. The docs pages stay on Starlight's own theme (lupios.css) and are outside this world, except where they host the shared identification key, which falls back to Starlight's colours there.
keyCharacteristics: Navy plate background, edge to edge, with ice hairlines as the only structure.
Alegreya (display, names, italic Latin) over Alegreya Sans (body) and Alegreya Sans SC (labels), JetBrains Mono for commands.
One ochre, reserved for what the reader is pointed at.
Real screenshots as plates, annotated with numbered circular field marks and leader lines.
Flat: no cards, no glow, no gradients.
One authored motion moment; everything else is a quiet state transition.

rules.name: The Pointed-At Rule
rules.body: Ochre marks only what the reader is being pointed at: a status, a focus, a chosen state, the answer to the key, LupiOS among its neighbours. Never decoration, never a second brand colour, never more than one pointed-at thing per view in normal reading.

rules.name: The Ink-Not-Box Rule
rules.body: Emphasis is done by moving text up the ink ladder (dim, ink, frost, ice, ochre), not by putting it in a filled container.

rules.name: The Real Small Caps Rule
rules.body: Labels use the Alegreya Sans SC face with light tracking (0.03 to 0.06em). No `text-transform: uppercase`, no synthesized caps.

rules.name: The Italic Is a Name Rule
rules.body: Alegreya italic is reserved for names (species, Latin) and photo credits.

rules.name: The Flat Plate Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are the night plate itself. A thing is set apart by a hairline, never by a fill or a glow.

dos: Do keep every page of this world on the night plate (night) edge to edge, dark only.
Do structure with hairlines (hairline between sections and rows, hairline-strong above grid entries and around inset plates).
Do set content as accounts: heading column 4fr left, body 8fr right.
Do prove features with real screenshots as plates, annotated with numbered circular field marks, a legend and a provenance credit.
Do hold ochre for the pointed-at thing: status, focus ring, chosen state, key answer, LupiOS's own row.
Do use the Alegreya Sans SC face for labels and Alegreya italic for names and Latin.
Do make comparison tables collapse to labelled blocks per row below 52rem.
donts: Don't wrap content in cards: no filled or shadowed boxes around text groups. Bordered plates around photographs and the terminal transcript are the world's own material and stay.
Don't add glow, gradients or a gradient hero over an icon-card grid.
Don't introduce a second warm accent or use ochre decoratively.
Don't fake small caps with uppercase transforms or wide tracking.
Don't add motion beyond the plate's line draw and mark landing; state changes only ease colour.
Don't invent screenshots, users, numbers or testimonials for plates or marks.
